best_for: Gamers who want to play a home PC's games from a laptop or another room, and creative pros who need a low-lag view of a fast Windows or Mac workstation.

points.title: Low lag at 60 frames per second
points.text: Parsec streams a desktop at 60 FPS over encrypted peer-to-peer connections, with keyboard, mouse and gamepad support. Sharing a link lets a friend join your game or a colleague see your screen.

points.title: Free covers personal gaming
points.text: The free Personal plan includes the core streaming features. It and the Individuals plan are licensed for personal, non-commercial use only; work use needs Teams or Enterprise.

points.title: What the paid plans add
points.text: Individuals (Warp) is USD 8.33 per month billed yearly and adds up to three monitors, 4:4:4 color, privacy mode and Wacom pressure and tilt. Teams is USD 30 and Enterprise USD 45 per user per month billed yearly. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Only Windows and Mac can host
points.text: You can host from Windows 10 or later and macOS 10.15 or later. Linux is a client only, so you connect from it but cannot share a Linux desktop.

points.title: Linux build is not Flathub-verified
points.text: The Linux build is a small x64 Flatpak that Flathub does not mark as verified. Parsec's own site lists Ubuntu 22.04 as its Linux target.

points.title: No rollback on any platform
points.text: This site keeps only the current version for Windows, macOS and Linux. If you need an older build, you will not find it here.

points.title: Windows install scope
points.text: The Windows installer comes in per-user and all-users forms, x64 only. The Mac package is universal for Intel and Apple Silicon.
